posts.author: KrillDes
posts.body:
Hi! I would like to discuss with users several important points for me regarding both the development of the site and plugins for RPG Maker MZ.
Regarding the site​
I see further development as adding a navigation menu to guides (some of them can be quite long and you don't always want to view all the content). I also thought about introducing the ability to register and leave comments on posts/plugin cards. But now I don't see the need for this.
Now about RPGMZ plugins​
I plan to release minimally tested plugins for beta testing (this will include both free and paid plugins). This will allow me to focus on writing detailed guides and creating new plugins while someone else tests my work, and then give my recommendations on what should be added, corrected or changed.
I am also thinking about creating something similar to my FS_Core plugin. But the idea is not in forced functionality or improvements (as some other popular developers do), but in debugged, general and universal mechanisms for working with RPGMZ, which my existing plugins will use (yes, they will depend on this plugin in the future and will not be able to work without it).
Anyway, these are just my personal thoughts, and it is not a fact that everything said will be implemented. I would like to know the opinion of the community, RPGM game developers and plugin developers.
The full post can be read on the
website
UPD: Has anyone tried reading the text in full? It's not very nice to get hate because of a mistranslation of the text that distorts my thoughts

Let's start from the beginning. Just recently I found a translation error, indicating "bad" instead of "minimal". Regarding testing.
I thoroughly test all declared functionality so that the plugin does not conflict. But I cannot test absolutely all cases.
I'll give an example on my own plugin InventorySystem. I tested all the available functionality, but didn't take into account a funny moment: if you add an item to the system for one character (using the global plugin method), and then add an item to another character using the standard RPGMZ command, he will have two items. The current one and the one previously added to the other character.
It is precisely these types of errors that I mean when I talk about testing by other users.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
It’s rather normal for unexpected issues to be discovered. The endless combinations of both plugin application and additional plugins someone might use are recipe for that.
Many plugin developers maintain their plugins, whether here or a personal website, and issue updates, compatibility patches, and bug fixes based on that feedback.
I think what’s happening here is that announcing that type of activity in a thread like this unintentionally made it appear strange since it’s rather normal and even somewhat expected that the plugin will be maintained after release.
